summary: In the workout builder (step 3), the 'Add exercise' button, which used to show a 'TODO' alert, now opens a modal listing exercises grouped by muscle (filtered by the chosen equipment, no stretches); clicking one adds it to the workout. Adds a read-only server action to fetch the exercise catalog, translations, and CSS fixes for modal backdrops.

statements.text: Nothing flagged — plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.
statements.why: Only UI and a read-only catalog query of public exercise data; nothing saved, deleted, charged or exposed.

statements.text: • The agent changed how the app looks, on every screen size and on small screens like phones (in src/shared/styles/globals.css).
statements.why: globals.css:73-100 adds unconditional .modal-backdrop full-viewport and scrollbar-gutter rules plus a repeated 768px block; now correctly says all screen sizes, though it doesn't say it's about modal backdrops.

statements.text: • The agent also changed locales/en.ts, locales/es.ts, locales/fr.ts, locales/pt.ts, locales/ru.ts and 2 more files, in ways plain can't describe yet.
